title: A night on the terrace
body: After staying a week at a wedding in the neighbouring village, the narrator returned home and found her grandmother in tears. She had never seen her cry, even in the most difficult situations. When she asked if everything was all right, her grandmother only nodded and did not reply. That night, as the family slept on the open terrace under a full summer moon, the grandmother came and sat beside the narrator and gently touched her forehead. She began to speak about her childhood: how she had lost her mother when she was young, how nobody had guided her, how girls were not sent to school in those days, and how she had always quietly regretted it, making sure that her children and grandchildren studied well.
